basic_info.description: Exceptional 10-Unit Apartment Building in Twin Peaks with Penthouse and Downtown Views.  Introducing a rare gem in urban living in the heart of San Francisco's Twin Peaks neighborhood! This well-maintained 1960s 10-unit apartment building offers a blend of vintage charm and modern convenience. Situated in a prime location, the property features an elevator, diverse floor plans, and stunning downtown views from the penthouse unit. Property Features: Unit Mix: 5 One-Bedroom/One-Bathroom Units, 3 Two-Bedroom/One-Bathroom Units, 2 Two-Bedroom/Two-Bathroom Units, including a penthouse with breathtaking downtown views. Garage Parking: Secure and convenient for tenants. Laundry Room: On-site facility for tenant ease. Outdoor Space: Select units offer private outdoor areas for added living enjoyment.  Elevator: Provides easy access, a key tenant amenity. This property is an excellent investment opportunity, appealing to a wide range of tenants with its varied floor plans and desirable features. Its mid-century design and timeless construction provide a solid foundation for potential updates or maintaining its classic appeal. Located close to shopping, dining, and entertainment, with easy access to major transportation routes, this property combines convenience, comfort, and style.
